entities.name: Almaaz
entities.description: The third largest of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria, the only nation to survive the Brothers' War, the Dark Age and the Ice Age without crumbling.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Almaaz lies.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: The capital of Almaaz, destroyed in the Brothers' War and rebuilt about 1300 years later slightly west of the original site.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Ruler of the Fallaji Empire to whom Almaazan songmages surrendered.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Sent by Mishra to Almaaz to oversee iron and lumber harvesting.

entities.name: Almaazan songmages
entities.description: Songmages of Sumifa who surrendered to Mishra and offered their powers to the Fallaji Empire.

entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: The empire Mishra led, of which Fallajia is a tiny remnant.

entities.name: Rigida
entities.description: Ancient ice beings who ruled most of Almaaz during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war during which Sumifa fell.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: The event after which Terisiare broke into several islands.

entities.name: Great Glacier
entities.description: A glacier that buried western Almaaz including the Halquina Mountains.

entities.name: Thabit
entities.description: A song-mage of Almaaz who played an important role in the rebellion of Epityr against Sheoltun.

entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: A beast bound on Sarraza whose release in 3050 AR destroyed the Chimes.

entities.name: Erg Desert
entities.description: Desert in the western half of Almaaz from which dune raiders attacked Almaazan cities.

events.summary: Almaazan songmages of Sumifa surrender to Mishra and offer their powers to the Fallaji Empire to avoid destruction.
events.quote: surrendered to Mishra and offered their powers to the Fallaji Empire in the war to avoid the destruction of their nation

events.summary: Mishra sends Ashnod to Almaaz to oversee iron and lumber harvesting; civil war breaks out after the Fall of Sumifa.
events.quote: although civil war eventually broke out after the Fall of Sumifa

events.summary: After the Brothers' War, Almaazan cities are attacked by dune raiders and thirst-crazed tribes from the Erg Desert.
events.quote: Almaazan cities were attacked by dune raiders or thirst-crazed military tribes from the Erg Desert

events.summary: During the Ice Age the Rigida rule most of Almaaz and the Great Glacier buries the west; a new Sumifa is established in 1300 AR.
events.quote: In 1300 AR , a new Sumifa was established slightly west of the original site of old Sumifa.

events.summary: After the Flooding of Terisiare, Almaaz's rule is reestablished with Sumifa as capital; in 3050 AR the buried ruins of old Sumifa are found.
events.quote: In 3050 AR , the buried ruins of old Sumifa were found in the desert.

events.summary: The Beast of the Hours is released in 3050 AR, destroying the Chimes.
events.quote: Destroyed in 3050 AR upon the release of the Beast of the Hours .
